_comment: Needs-expert-review register. Each item is exported into the data pack as a review flag so the game and instructors can see what is provisional. Close an item by setting status to 'resolved' with the reviewer's decision.

items.title: Corn nitrogen rate: SL129 plant-population table vs. interim yield-goal rule

options.summary: SL129 Table 2, irrigated corn: 180 / 210 / 240 lb N/A at 20,000 / 25,000 / 30,000 plants/acre
1.37 lb N per bushel of yield potential (interim, approved September 3, 2025): 137 / 206 / 274 / 343 lb N/ac at 100 / 150 / 200 / 250 bu/ac

items.notes: Both rules are stored in the data pack. Default chosen by the project owner on 2026-10-20 so that Increment 3 tests can match SL129. Changing the default is a one-line edit here.

items.title: Re-pricing Georgia 2024 custom rates for Florida diesel and labor
items.notes: No sourced Florida-vs-Georgia diesel and farm-labor cost ratios have been approved yet. Proposed method: factor = 1 + fuel_share x (FL_diesel/GA_diesel - 1) + labor_share x (FL_wage/GA_wage - 1), with all four inputs cited.

items.title: Confirm the two SSURGO map units represent irrigated corn fields in the Suwannee Valley
items.current_default: Field 1: Blanton-Alpin-Bonneau complex, 0 to 5 percent slopes; Field 2: Bonneau-Blanton-Padlock complex, 0 to 5 percent slopes
items.notes: Chosen to contrast deep sand (low water holding) with loamy sand (higher water holding). Names confirmed against SSURGO when the fetch runs.

items.title: Confirm which workbook cells feed game values (yield, price, land rent, hauling, interest, crop insurance)
items.current_default: Named workbook column per field (budget_fields.col in pipeline/sources/regions/suwannee.json): yield Marketing!C7 (205 bu/A); gross price Marketing!C8 ($5.20/bu); net farm-gate price Marketing!C27 ($4.78/bu, paid by the market channel); crop insurance premium, Revenue Protection 75%, Marketing column D ($12.20/A, a separate cost); budget total net farm-gate crop revenue Marketing!D39 ($967.70/A, used only to reconcile); land rent FieldDetails!E19 ($285.71/A, rented only); own hauling Marketing!D22 ($0); operating interest OperatingRates!C22
items.notes: Spot-check 2026-10-20 found the first-numeric-cell rule read whole-farm rent (FieldDetails!D19 = $40,000) as $/acre; fixed by picking named columns, and validation rejects per-acre costs outside 0..revenue per acre. Resolved 2026-11-05 by project-owner decision (option C): the Marketing sheet shows gross revenue $1,066.00/A, minus buyer drying fees $24.60/A ($0.12/bu) and buying-point hauling $61.50/A ($0.30/bu), gives net farm-gate sales revenue C27 = $4.78/bu ($979.90/A); minus the crop insurance premium (Revenue Protection, 75%) of $12.20/A ($0.06/bu) gives total net farm-gate crop revenue C39 = $4.72/bu ($967.70/A). Additional crop revenues (insurance proceeds, farm program payments, crop residue) are $0. The game pays C27 and carries the premium as a separate, optional cost; validation checks yield x price - premium = D39. Owned and rented workbooks match on these rows.

items.title: Owned land: property tax, utilities, other ownership costs, and land appreciation
items.current_default: Not yet modelled: the 2026 owned budget carries $0 land rent (FieldDetails!E19) and $0 mortgage (FieldDetails!E20), so owned land currently has no land cost
items.notes: Decided 2026-10-20: owned land must carry property tax, utilities and other related ownership costs, and must gain value over the period of ownership. Sources and method are pending approval. Deferred to a later increment on 2026-11-02 by project-owner decision: no ownership-cost source is approved for Increment 2, so owned land carries no land cost for now; revisit when a cited source and method are approved.
